title: Interior art: Velvet Undertow to the quality bar, venue art kit, interior audit

items.name: Velvet Undertow rebuilt as a V2 nightclub (standout of storefront 39): back bar with lit shelves and ~250 bottles, marble bar with teal under-glow, stools, coffered ceiling with magenta coves and downlights, mirror ball with moving spots, fluted wall with uplights, neon sign with palm, glowing host/DJ stand, velvet-rope lounge, candle lanterns, palms with uplights, entry portal and pillars, sconces, haze
Club side by side with ref_52 and with the old in-game club (ref_53); self score 6.5/10
Polished stone floor reflecting the room: box-projected reflection probe, one cube face per frame, NaN-safe, same-size placeholder so the swap never recompiles
Procedural bottle generator: 8 shapes, 40 invented brands in one label atlas, 2 draw calls per shape, baked light per bottle, liquid glow
Neon sign generator (script, block, deco, casual, serif lettering; palm, cocktail, star, wave, moon icons)
Interior art kit: venue, dining and fashion fixtures, premium surfaces, haze, candles, mirror ball (src/world/interiors/kit, fixtures/venue.js, dining.js, fashion.js)

Kit applied in game: bars (lounge, dive, sports, tiki), restaurants (cuban, trattoria, steak, seafood, noodle; diner for fast food), cafes (ventanita, roaster, cozy; bakeries), hotel lobbies (deco, luxury, motel), clothing and shoe stores (resort, streetwear/sneakers, luxury)

items.name: Convenience store (Night Owl Mart business type): waxed-floor reflection probe
Venue staff and guests placed and posed from the ped system (bartenders, DJ, bouncer, seated, standing at the bar, dancing, leaning; clerks and browsers in shops)
Streaming cost: idle-time texture prewarm, async shader precompile against the post target, budgeted texture upload, probe one face per frame
